title: Story premise ENT119: The Sidewalk Chalk Detour
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: Stopping is clear. Going somewhere else is missing. Takeaway/theme: When blocking a route, show a usable next option.
description: A volunteer wants visitors to avoid a pretend wet-paint mural on the floor, but a single STOP sign makes everyone bunch up. They add a clearly marked alternate path around the work area and an arrow back to the original route; traffic flows gently while the painter adds the final flower.
